obligations.text: For an unwitnessed confined attempt, the operator's provider token never appears in the child's environment, arguments, per-run directory or any file the attempt can read or leaves behind.

Each attempt gets its own gateway token, written to a 0600 no-replace file in its per-run configuration directory and given to the provider only through the adapter's declared route, accepted by the gateway only for that attempt, and refused by it once the attempt has an outcome.
The gateway listens on loopback only, forwards only to the provider authority its adapter names, and refuses any request without the attempt's token.
A gateway that cannot start, or an adapter that cannot be routed through one, refuses the launch with exit 2; it never falls back to placing the provider token in the child's environment.

A scan of the child's environment, every file in its per-run directory and every file the attempt leaves finds no byte of the provider token; a request with a revoked or another attempt's token is refused by the gateway.

record.summary: Replaces spec 042's delivery of the operator's provider token in the child's environment with a loopback authentication gateway the supervisor owns. The child receives the gateway's address and a short-lived token minted for its attempt, through a 0600 file in the per-run configuration directory; the gateway checks that token and forwards with the real one, and revokes it when the attempt ends. The provider token never appears in the child's environment or files. Claude Code's honouring of a base-URL override with an OAuth token in print mode is measured, unconfined; the confined measurement is part of acceptance.
record.title: The supervisor holds the provider token behind a loopback gateway; the child holds only a per-attempt token
